messages:
marc: Heads-up — we need a vendor/submodule bump for the kernels bundle before tomorrow's cutoff for release/1.8. CI is failing on mac/gpu due to prebuilt kernel checksum mismatch. Can someone take this?

sasha: I can pick this up. Which submodule commit do we want to pin to?

marc: I tested against upstream commit a1b2c3d4 (short sha). Locally `make vendor` produced vendor/kernels-20260204.tar.gz and tests passed. Two things: update third_party/kernels submodule pointer and regenerate the packaged vendor artifact so CI pulls the right tarball.

devon: Commands you'd want to run?

marc: Use this sequence — copy/paste:

```bash
git checkout -b release/deps/kernels-bump
cd third_party/kernels
git fetch origin
git checkout a1b2c3d4
cd ../..
./tools/update_vendor.sh --pack kernels   # regenerates vendor/kernels-*.tar.gz and updates checksums
git add third_party/kernels vendor/kernels-*.tar.gz go.sum
git commit -m "vendor: bump kernels submodule + vendor tarball"
gh pr create --title "vendor: kernels bump (a1b2c3d4)" --body "Vendor bump for kernel fixes on mac/gpu" --base release/1.8
```

ryan: Note: infra caches artifacts by filename. If the tool produces the same tarball name we should ensure checksum changes get propagated — either add a timestamp suffix or update the artifact manifest. Otherwise CI might pull the old cached file.

sasha: Good call. update_vendor.sh already appends date, but CI cache keys might still collide. I'll force-update the manifest and include the short sha in the tarball name if the script doesn't.

lisa: I'll run the Windows build once the PR is open. Also pinging infra to warm the GPU cache for the new kernel build.

ci-bot: Build queued for PR (draft) — linux/gpu, linux/cpu, windows/amd64. Status will post here.

devon: Reminder: when you change go.sum or any vendored libs, run `go mod vendor` on the release branch before merge so the vendor/ tree stays consistent. And double-check we don't accidentally bump unrelated deps.

marc: Cutoff reminder: branch cut for release/1.8 is 2026-02-05 17:00 UTC. We need this merged before then or we risk a follow-up patch. If CI flakes, call it out early so we can postpone non-blocking changes.

sasha: Opening PR now — draft created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/1287 (draft). I'll update the description with the checksum notes and CI artifacts.

lisa: Quick local run: Windows build + unit tests passed against a1b2c3d4. I also validated the new tarball checksum matches the manifest.

ryan: I'll do a final review when CI is green. If all looks good, please leave the PR as normal (no squash) so the vendor commits remain explicit.

sasha: CI is green on linux/gpu & linux/cpu, windows still running. Pushed fixes to manifest.

ci-bot: windows/amd64 job succeeded. All checks green for PR #1287.

sasha: Merged PR into release/1.8 and pushed tag release/1.8-deps-kernels-bump (merged by @sasha at 1769004300).

marc: Thanks! Post-merge action items: created INFRA-564 to add artifact cache invalidation flag to vendor publish flow and assigned to @ryan. I'll also add a short note to the release checklist so we don't forget the submodule + package step next time. :thumbsup:

devon: Great. Closing loop — please paste the final kernel short-sha in the release notes so QA knows which runtime bits changed.

marc: Will do.
